tools.name: investigate_faie_evidence
tools.description: Run a bounded FAIE evidence investigation. Public MCP investigations are ephemeral previews and do not persist the caller question into the shared investigation archive.

tools.name: compare_faie_candidates
tools.description: Run the same bounded FAIE evidence rubric across 2 to 8 candidate regions or sites. The returned rank is evidence-readiness only, not site suitability or an investment recommendation.

tools.name: get_faie_signal_snapshot
tools.description: Return the latest public-safe FAIE signal snapshot. Read-only and non-transactional.

tools.name: get_faie_health
tools.description: Return FAIE resident, source-health, and signal-count status without exposing private investigation content.
